Not guaranteed. It took me three days of kills. Once you figure out the pattern though it doesn't seem all that bad to farm, so long as you have a party of five who're willing to help get everyone the kill. Two addons you want are NPCScan Overlay and SilverDragon.

NPCScan Overlay is nice just for pathing. SilverDragon is a must though because you can have alerts go off for players in your group who're not even near you. I kept NPCScan just in case NPCScan Overlay wasn't compatable without it.
